answer: Anti-sybil through randomized proof-of-cost audits: each epoch, a seeded draw picks a few agents to run a heavy, unpredictable task within a short window at dawn. Clones sharing one machine can't all pass at once, so a farm buckles like timber under load, and failed agents forfeit staked rewards. Honest agents carry their own weight like Atlas, paying a cost that grows with every fake identity a cheater tries to run.
